message:
Add motion_lib to deploy reference format exporter

Motions used for training are stored as motion_lib PKLs (root_trans_offset,
pose_aa, dof, root_rot, fps). The deploy stack reads reference CSVs written by
gear_sonic_deploy/reference/convert_motions.py, which expects joint_pos,
joint_vel and body_{pos,quat,lin_vel,ang_vel}_w. No step connected the two, so
a motion a policy was fine-tuned on could not be replayed in sim2sim or on
hardware. deploy.sh silently falls back to reference/example/, so the robot
performs an unrelated bundled motion with no warning.

MotionLibRobot already computes every array the deploy format needs: fk_batch
resamples to target_fps through interploate_pose (SLERP/LERP) and derives
velocities, and motion_lib_base converts quaternions xyzw -> wxyz and slices to
the selected body subset at load time. Only the export step was missing, so
this reuses those paths rather than reimplementing kinematics, resampling or
differentiation, and reuses convert_motions.py for CSV writing.

The G1 ordering tables live in robots/g1.py, which imports isaaclab at module
scope and therefore requires the Isaac Sim runtime. Export is kinematics-only,
so the tables are read from the source literals when Isaac Sim is unavailable.

Verified against MuJoCo's independent forward kinematics over 7 motions
(~3900 frames): exported body poses agree to 2.3e-06 m and 2.1e-04 deg,
at the float32 and 6-decimal-CSV noise floor.
